verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a skill and plugin bundle, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only skill-file installation (npx skills, Claude Code, Codex and Copilot plugin marketplaces), and none of it describes an MCP server endpoint or 'mcp serve' mode. Plugin and marketplace installation is a different distribution mechanism and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
